releaseDate.value: April 2024 (Core v0.5 / Flash v1.5 / Edge v1.5 Apr launch versions)

source.quote: Reka Core v0.5        Q2’24   Apr launch version

Our standard models have a context length of 8K for our regular models. Reka Flash
and Reka Core have 128K for long context models for retrieval and long document tasks.

modalities.value: text, image, video, and audio inputs; text outputs only

source.quote: supporting text, image, video, and audio inputs. For now, our model only supports text outputs.

languages.value: 32 deliberately multilingual languages (tier-weighted) plus multilingual Wikipedia covering 110 languages

source.quote:
Approximately 15% of our pretraining data is explicitly (and deliberately) multilingual,
comprising 32 diverse languages tier-weighted (roughly by frequency in the wild).

totalParams.value: Edge 7B dense; Flash 21B dense; Core size not reported

source.quote:
Edge       7B dense         4.5T          8K            64K            Nov 2023
             Flash      21B dense         5T           8K           128K            Nov 2023

architecture.value: modular encoder-decoder Transformer (SwiGLU, GQA, RoPE, RMSNorm); dense

source.quote:
Our overall architecture (Figure 2) is a modular encoder-decoder architecture
supporting text, image, video, and audio inputs.

trainingData.value: publicly available and proprietary/licensed text, images, videos, and audio; Flash ~5T and Edge ~4.5T filtered language tokens

source.quote:
The training data comprises a mixture of publicly available and proprietary/licensed datasets with a dataset
knowledge cutoff of November 2023.

trainingCompute.value: predominantly Nvidia H100s; peak ~2.5K H100s and 2.5K A100s; Flash and Edge trained on several hundreds of H100s over several weeks
